title: PickerStep
description: Overrides for the picker step. Each field replaces the page's default as a whole.

sites.description: The suggested sites, in display order. The page groups them by section. Every id needs a bundled icon and translated copy, so a new site still needs a page release.

id.description: Stable key for the site's copy, its bundled icon and the addFavorites message

url.description: The URL saved as the favorite

title.description: The site's name, shown on its tile and used as the favorite's title

section.description: The group the tile appears in

existingFavorites.description: URLs of the favorites the user already has, filled in from the shouldShowTopSitesPicker answer. Never more than 4, because native answers no at 5 or more. The page shows any suggested site whose hostname matches one of these, after dropping a leading "www.", as picked and locked, and leaves it out of addFavorites. Unparseable URLs are skipped.
